messages:
maya: Quick ask — can someone run a throughput sweep on staging for the new small-batch path? Trying to validate queueing behavior with max_batch_size=8 and var_max_tokens=512. Goal: p95 latency < 120ms at ~200 rps.

sam: On it, I can kick off loadgen in ~15m. Which model variant do you want me to test first — quant-8 or fp16?

maya: quant-8 first. If that looks clean, run fp16 right after. Keep same seed so traces line up.

sam: OK. Loadgen args I plan to use:
```
--concurrency 200
--rps 200
--max_batch_size 8
--var_max_tokens 512
--duration 6m
--model redwood-v2-small-quant8
```

lee: Heads-up: watch the queue_depth metric (/metrics/queue_length). Last small-batch run had brief spikes when backlog > 40 that changed how batching behaved.

sam: noted — I'll add a dashboard tile and a temporary alert for queue_length > 30 so we catch it live.

ops-bot: perf-run scheduled by sam for 1723456840, job id perf-20240301-58

maya: Thanks — can you also capture raw traces (trace_id) so we can correlate warmup and KV-cache behavior?

sam: Will attach traces + loadgen logs to the job. Pinging @ajay for profiler / heap dumps if we need deeper memory/kv state.

ajay: I can grab a quick heap/kv-cache snapshot after ~2 minutes into the run. Please add me to job watchers.

maya: Added you. Also include a small sample of request sizes in the artifacts — I've seen outliers around 3.5–4k tokens that skew overall throughput.

sam: Good call. I'll run with a token-size filter for 0–1024 and then a second run for >1024 tokens so we can compare.

perf-bot: Reminder: keep runs under the 3-run-per-day quota for dedicated nodes.

maya: Good reminder — if we hit the quota we'll prioritize the quant run.

sam: Starting now, posting results + graphs in this thread when done. :rocket:

lee: :eyes:
